lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 distinct vertical white lines are visible across the lateral torso; spacing is approximately uniform in the mid-section with narrowing intervals observed in the anterior shoulder region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The third and fourth lines from the posterior terminate in the mid-torso region, failing to reach the dorsal ridge; the most anterior line on the shoulder is abbreviated and only visible on the lower half of the torso mass.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of three high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower haunch, positioned superior to the white posterior fringe.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two distinct spots on the mid-haunch align along a horizontal axis relative to the torso orientation.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns follow a spiral lyrate trajectory, diverging laterally from the frontal bone at approximately 45-degree angles before curving medially towards the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal tips is approximately 3.2 times the pixel width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Light-colored ivory tips account for approximately the distal 12-15% of the total visible horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of two Red-billed Oxpeckers on the dorsal ridge; prominent white dorsal crest extending from the neck to the tail base; high-contrast yellow-orange pigmentation on the lower limbs transitioning to black above the carpus/tarsus.
